lines.t: (Yeah)
144 thousand… wake up.
No more sleepwalk.
Crown King. Time now.
Stand up, soldiers, this is not a game,
My King is a fire, not a church brand name.
He comes as a Judge with a war-time reign,
You still chase clout while they curse His name.
Get low, lay down, let your pride get slain,
You boast in your grind, but you lack real flame.
Repent, one-four-four, let your flesh die, man,
Let the Lion on the Throne put steel in your veins.
You 144, why you still sleepwalk?
Book in your hand but you mute when He talk.
Blood in the streets, kids chained in the dark,
Harlot on the throne while you sing in the park.You called lions, but you purr like a kitten,
Tatted with verses, but your heart ain’t smitten.
Whole world burnin’ in a digital prison,
You post one verse, then you’re back to your business.You see pulpits full of actors and fakes,
Peace on their lips while they serve up snakes.
They sell His kids for a seat with the masters,
You clap along, scared of losing your status.
He ain’t raise you just to build you a brand,
He ain’t crown you just to bow to a man.
You were born for the storm, not the show or the stands,
Drop your ego, put your face in His hands.
Stand up, soldiers, this is not a game,
My King is a fire, not a church brand name.
He comes as a Judge with a war-time reign,
You still chase clout while they curse His name.
Get low, lay down, let your pride get slain,
You boast in your grind, but you lack real flame.
Repent, one-four-four, let your flesh die, man,
Let the Lion on the Throne put steel in your veins.
He ain’t call you to cuddle with dead religion,
He ain’t send you to bow to their vain tradition.
You see the widows robbed, orphans on sale,
You scroll past fast like it’s “grace, never jail.”You forgot He’s a King with a rod in His hand,
Not a weak little meme for your Instagram.
He’s a Man of war with a sentence to hand,
And you play both sides just to please your fans.You scream “remnant,” but you live like cowards,
Talk like lions but you fold for the crowd.
You see the harlot drunk on the blood of the saints,
Still sip from her cup, still wear her paint.
This ain’t a game, this a death to your flesh,
This ain’t a brand, this a blood-bought crest.
Drop your throne, let the real King flex,
Bow now, get wrecked, then rise up next.
Stand up, soldiers, this is not a game,
My King is a fire, not a church brand name.
He comes as a Judge with a war-time reign,
You still chase clout while they curse His name.
Get low, lay down, let your pride get slain,
You boast in your grind, but you lack real flame.
Repent, one-four-four, let your flesh die, man,
Let the Lion on the Throne put steel in your veins.
This that trumpet in the gutter with a militant snap,
Streetlight gospel over hardcore trap.
No more deals, no more secret pacts,
Kiss the Son or get hit by His wrath.Altar on the pavement, cross on your back,
Code-red banner on a broken app.
Last call, last shot, last breath in your chest,
Alpha Judge, holy heat, no flesh left.
He’s jealous for the kids that the system devours,
Jealous for the ones locked up in your towers.
You count your tithes while they bleed in the alleys,
Pray long prayers, never leave your palace.He’s looking for the ones who will break rank clean,
Walk out the walls of the dead man’s dream.
Face to the floor, let Him strip that crown,
Burn your name up, let Him write His down.One-four-four, this a draft, not a choir,
You were chosen for the smoke, not the flyers.
You were forged to be blades in the hand of the King,
Not mascots, not brand reps, not cute little things.So tremble, then move, let your knees hit stone,
Let your face know dust, let your idols go.
Let the Judge be King in the core of your chest,
Then rise like a storm with His Name on your breath.
Stand up, soldiers, this is not a game,
My King is a fire, not a church brand name.
He comes as a Judge with a war-time reign,
You still chase clout while they curse His name.
Get low, lay down, let your pride get slain,
You boast in your grind, but you lack real flame.
Repent, one-four-four, let your flesh die, man,
Let the Lion on the Throne put steel in your veins.
No more compromise.
No more harlot wine.
No more borrowed thrones.
Bow to the King… or be ground to the bone.
